visualCharacteristics.layout: three logos per row on desktop, two on mobile, each centered in its cell
visualCharacteristics.stylingNotes: White section, logos centered with generous vertical padding, no text or links

contentPattern.structure: one row per logo: cell 1 logo image (alt text = company name); cell 2 text (left empty)
contentPattern.reason: Repeating look-alike logo items in a flowing grid that wraps; count can vary
contentPattern.variantReason: Image-only partner logo grid, three per row, centered, no text

usage: Use for a row or grid of partner, carrier or client logos; put a heading above it as default content.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any image-only logo strip. Use cards-icon for tiles with text and links.
